{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:", data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0].shape[0])

# Check the distribution of severity by arm
print("\nSeverity by arm:\n", pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity']))

# Check the distribution of sex by arm
print("\nSex by arm:\n", pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['sex']))

# Check the distribution of age by arm
print("\nAge by arm:\n", data.groupby('arm')['age'].describe())"}
